Settlement_Services.Framework.Defs.Settl.label: proficiency certification
Settlement_Services.Framework.Defs.Settl.description: A specialist placement that promotes a colonist by exactly one Progression: Education proficiency tier, in whichever track and next tier the pawn already qualifies for. Which tracks are available, and the pawn's own eligibility, are governed entirely by Progression: Education's own rules and settings.
